t: Release of the new integration type in CreateIntegration API - Used to add Microsoft Azure resources to the Amazon CloudWatch Omni context graph through an AWS Config connector for your Azure tenant.
Add aggregationTemporality and monotonicity to GetContextGraph MetricMetadata
Release of GetSpaceDataAccess API - Used to get temporary credentials, limited to the requested actions, for working with data in a space.
Updating max value for maxResults in SearchPrincipals API
Adds support for updating agentCoreEvaluationRoleArn in UpdateSpace API

Amazon CloudWatch Omni is now generally available, an AI-powered unified observability for AI agents, applications, and infrastructure. As part of it, organization centralization rules now support cross-account context graph centralization.
